clusters.title: Kharphuli / Sohkhlet / Sohtun & Myrthong
clusters.summary_khasi: Ki Kharphuli (bad Sohkhlet/Sohtun) ki ïakam kur bad ki Myrthong namar u parad Myrthong u la pynrieh bad pyllait im ïa ki ha ka thma ha Lyngngam.
clusters.summary_english: Kharphuli (and Sohkhlet/Sohtun) maintain an ïakam kur covenant with Myrthong after a Myrthong elder hid and saved them during a conflict in Lyngngam.
